label: Dynamic Viewpoint
description: Energetic and unusual camera positions for any subject — each names the camera's height, distance and what the position does to scale and motion.

items.name: drone-high
items.text: high drone shot looking steeply down from a hundred meters, the subject a small precise figure in a vast readable environment, its shadow stretching long across the ground plane

items.name: birds-eye-topdown
items.text: perfect nadir top-down view, the scene flattened into a graphic plan of shapes and cast shadows with no horizon left to orient by

items.name: worms-eye
items.text: extreme worm's-eye view with the camera at ground level looking straight up, the subject towering into converging verticals against open sky

items.name: dutch-tilt
items.text: Dutch tilt of a committed fifteen degrees, every stable line turned diagonal, restless tension injected into a static frame

items.name: pov-hands
items.text: first-person point of view, the viewer's own hands entering the lower frame edge in soft focus, the scene beyond them the real subject

items.name: isometric
items.text: clean isometric three-quarter overhead perspective with no vanishing point, parallel lines staying parallel, the scene reading as a precise miniature diorama

items.name: through-foreground
items.text: shot through out-of-focus foreground elements, a soft dark frame of blur layering the scene with voyeuristic depth

items.name: reflection-only
items.text: the subject present only as its reflection in glass, still water or chrome, the reflecting surface's own texture rippling through the likeness

items.name: tracking-side
items.text: side-on tracking view locked to the moving subject, the background streaked into horizontal ribbons while the subject stays pin-sharp

items.name: macro-distance
items.text: macro-range closeness a hand-width from the subject, the focus plane a few millimeters deep, familiar textures turning into landscape

items.name: low-chase-cam
items.text: chase camera skimming centimeters above the ground behind the subject, surface rushing beneath and the world pouring toward the vanishing point
